extracted.name: Skillet Sea Scallops
extracted.description: This skillet sea scallops recipe for breaded sea scallops is lightly fried in butter and olive oil and served with a lemon-wine sauce in this quick dish.
instruction_lines: Combine bread crumbs and salt in a large resealable plastic bag. Add scallops, a few at a time, and shake to coat. Repeat with remaining scallops.
Melt butter with olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; sauté scallops until browned and opaque, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer scallops to a plate; keep warm.
Stir wine, lemon juice, parsley, and garlic into skillet; bring to a boil. Simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes. Pour lemon-wine sauce over scallops; serve.
